contents_summary: ZIP with one 3-page PDF: Figure S1 (two EKG images, baseline and after the intervention), Table S1 (medication list by date) and Table S2 (additional labs and clinical parameters by date) for the index patient.

pages.contents: Heading "Supplementary materials" and Figure S1: two resting EKG tracing images labelled A and B with the caption "EKG readouts at baseline (A) and following the intervention (B). Identifying information has been redacted." Each tracing shows 12-lead rhythm strips with machine-printed header text (measurement boxes and an interpretation text box).
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient EKG figure; the caption and the main article (b00007, b00011) tie the tracings to the index patient at baseline and after the intervention. Only the caption is transcribed; machine-printed values and interpretation text inside the images are pixel content and are not extracted as facts.
limitations: Despite the caption saying identifying information was redacted, both tracings still show printed institution text, a supervising physician name line and a date and time stamp (values not copied); black boxes cover only part of the header.
Printed EKG measurements, heart rate, blood pressure and interpretation text inside the images are not transcribed or extracted as facts.

pages.contents: Table S1. Medication changes: a numbered list of eleven medications with doses under the date column 05.14.2020, and two medications (Bystolic and Vitamin D2) under the date column 06.12.2020.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Index-patient medication table named in the main article (b00006, b00027); every printed row is transcribed.
limitations: Dates are printed month.day.year; the table states no action (started, stopped or continued).

pages.contents: Table S2. Additional labs and clinical parameters: ten date columns (5.14.2020 to 6.11.2020) by rows for carbon dioxide, LVEF, NT pro-BNP, Modified Bruce treadmill exercise time, BMI, body weight, glucose and IV fluids.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Index-patient serial table named in the main article (b00007, b00027); every non-empty cell is transcribed.
limitations: Blank cells are not transcribed and are not negatives; several values conflict with main article Table 1 or text and are review-only.
EKG image pixels are not extracted as facts; blank Table S2 cells are not transcribed.
Table S2 carbon dioxide on 5.23.2020 and 5.24.2020, the 5.14.2020 treadmill time and the 06.12.2020 vitamin D form conflict with the main article and are review-only.
